payload.name: Louise Rawsthorne
payload.pay_note: The council's pay policy statement says the chief executive is the head of paid service — the most senior member of staff — and is also the council's returning officer, who runs elections and is paid separate fees for it. From the council's list of salaries over £50,000, published in May 2026. This is the published pay range for the post, not what any individual is paid.
payload.summary: Louise Rawsthorne is the council's most senior employee. Officers are hired, not elected: they carry out what councillors decide. Four executive directors report to her.
